source_span: We think the move is a bear-steepener: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold, so the long end is doing the work as term premium rebuilds.
source_chain: 10-year breaks 4.40% therefore JPM reads it as a bear-steepener because the Fed-anchored front end leaves the long end to do the work via rebuilding term premium therefore JPM pays 5s30s at 62bp/stop 48bp, while Citi calls it a positioning flush that holds 4.40% on a close; invalidation: a hot core PCE (0.3% consensus) Thursday validates the steepener, a soft print does not reverse it while the Fed stays on hold.
pulse_chain: 10-year breaks 4.40% on Friday therefore JPM reads it as a bear-steepener because the Fed-on-hold front end is pinned, leaving the long end to do the work via term premium rebuilding therefore the desk pays 5s30s at 62bp/stop 48bp, while Citi disagrees and calls it a positioning flush that holds 4.40% on a close; invalidation: Thursday's core PCE (0.3% consensus) decides it — hot validates the steepener, soft does not reverse it while the Fed stays put.
